scripts.script1: Hi {{first_name}}, {{dealer_name}} AI assistant here. Would you like help with registration renewal?
scripts.script3: Hi {{first_name}}, {{dealer_name}} AI assistant here. Would you like help with your car's regular maintenance?
scripts.opening: Hello po, {{first_name}}! I'm the automated assistant of {{dealer_name}}. Your {{vehicle_model}} registration is due on {{renewal_due}}; would you like help booking a visit?
scripts.followup1: Hello po, {{first_name}}! Following up on your registration renewal. Would you like assistance booking a visit?
scripts.followup2: Hi po, {{first_name}}! This is our final reminder on this channel about your registration renewal. You can reply here whenever you'd like assistance.
scripts.switch: Hello po, {{first_name}}! Continuing our registration reminder here after our earlier messages. Would you like help scheduling a visit?
scripts.positive: Certainly po. What date would you prefer for your visit?
scripts.booking: Your {{service_offering}} appointment is recorded for {{appointment_time}} po. This does not reserve a real dealership appointment.
scripts.rescheduling: Your appointment has been moved to {{appointment_time}} po.
scripts.cancellation: Your appointment has been cancelled po.
scripts.privacy: This automated reminder uses the customer record configured for this conversation po. I can record a request for a representative, or stop future reminders.
scripts.handoff: I've recorded your request for a dealership representative po. A person has not been notified automatically.
scripts.closing: Thank you po! You can message here for help with dealership services.
scripts.redirect: I can help with registration renewals, dealership services, and appointments po. What would you like to check?
scripts.optout: I've stopped campaign reminders across your linked channels po.

taglishScripts.opening: Hello po, {{first_name}}! Automated assistant ako ng {{dealer_name}}. Due ang registration ng {{vehicle_model}} ninyo sa {{renewal_due}}; gusto po ba ninyong mag-book ng visit?
taglishScripts.positive: Sige po. Anong petsa ang gusto ninyo para sa visit?
taglishScripts.booking: Naitala na ang {{service_offering}} appointment ninyo sa {{appointment_time}} po. Wala pa itong reservation sa totoong dealership.
taglishScripts.rescheduling: Nailipat na ang appointment ninyo sa {{appointment_time}} po.
taglishScripts.cancellation: Cancelled na ang appointment ninyo po.
taglishScripts.privacy: Galing sa customer record para sa usapang ito ang reminder po. Maaari tayong mag-record ng request para sa representative o itigil ang reminders.
taglishScripts.handoff: Naitala ko na ang request ninyo para sa representative po. Wala pang taong awtomatikong na-notify.
taglishScripts.redirect: Makakatulong ako sa registration renewal, dealership services, at appointments po. Ano ang gusto ninyong malaman?
taglishScripts.optout: Itinigil ko na ang campaign reminders sa lahat ng linked channels ninyo po.
taglishScripts.closing: Salamat po! Message lang para sa tulong sa dealership services.
